Platform Engineer — Harbor

Harbor is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our developer experience team, improving build and deploy tooling used by every engineer at Harbor.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with CI/CD systems
- Experience with deployment pipeline design
- Comfortable working directly with internal customers

Harbor is based in the Bay Area with a hybrid policy.
